How did we do?

Help us welcome the next person even better.

We want every person who enters The Nativity to feel welcomed without feeling overwhelmed. If you visited us recently, we would be grateful to hear about your experience.

This survey is optional, and you may complete it anonymously. If something confused you, that is worth telling us — it is the kind of thing a parish stops noticing about itself.

Tell us about your visit

Nine short questions and three you can leave blank. Nothing here asks who you are unless you ask us to get in touch at the end.

Open the survey
1. Was this your first visit to an Orthodox church?
2. When you arrived, did someone welcome you?
3. Did you know where to find a prayer or service book?
4. Did you feel comfortable asking questions?
5. Did you know that you were invited to coffee hour after the Liturgy?
6. Did someone introduce themselves or help you feel connected to the parish?
10. Would you like someone from The Nativity to contact you?

Demonstration only. Nothing entered here is sent or stored. Before this could be used, the parish would need somewhere for the answers to go and someone whose job it is to read them — the Welcome Ministry, if the Council establishes one.
